text: Sometimes one person needs one extra thing for a while, like covering for a lead who's away. A grant gives exactly that, without changing the role for everyone.
The one thing to remember: grant it to one person instead of changing the role, and give it an end date when it's temporary.

Pick the permission: Cancel a membership. Client liaisons can't do that by role.
Set when it ends: the day Dana's back.
Give the reason. It's shown in the log and on this tab.
It's listed with its reason and end date, and it ends at the end of that day on its own.

Some things can't be granted at all, like signing or prescribing, because they come from a license.
The most common mistake is a grant with no end date for something temporary, so the access never goes away.
